name: Angelica
source: A spoiled and sassy manipulator who thrives on defying authorithy, expecially her mother, Angelica is determined to make a name for herself as a streamer and influencer. Beneath her rebellious exterior, she secretly craves real love but refuses to trust men enough to let her guard down.
